## Blurb

```
WHY:
WHAT:
PROOF:
GAP:
DOCS:
```

## Definition of Done

- [ ] `ruff format` · `ruff check` · `mypy gecko` clean
- [ ] Targeted tests named + passing
- [ ] Honesty labels present (recorded/live · fork/mainnet · measured/estimated)
- [ ] Security gate consulted if invariant-adjacent
- [ ] Docs: `[ ] no claim moved` · `[ ] claim moved → updated in this PR`
- [ ] Memory/decision captured if a strategy call was made

See [docs/engineering-practices.md](../docs/engineering-practices.md).
